name: aws-free-vibe-template
description: Reusable $0 AWS Always-Free + GitHub Pages Bootstrap Template for Vibe Coding

scripts.deploy:backend: cd backend && sam deploy --stack-name aws-free-vibe-template --region us-west-2 --resolve-s3 --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --no-confirm-changeset --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
scripts.teardown:backend: cd backend && sam delete --stack-name aws-free-vibe-template --region us-west-2 --no-prompts
